title: Model catalog assets publish only from master push, never from pull_request runs
answers: why did the model catalog release not update on a PR
where does the model catalog get published to GitHub Releases
can a pull request run upload model-catalog assets or move the tag
which workflow job publishes the model catalog release
body:
Invariant: release publication for the model catalog runs only on `push` to `master` in mlflow/mlflow. Scheduled/manual runs generate, validate and open or update the automated PR (`create-pr` job). `pull_request` runs validate generation only.
Enforced by the job-level `if` on the `publish` job in .github/workflows/update-model-catalog.yml (`github.event_name == 'push' && github.ref == 'refs/heads/master'`), and by `sync` skipping push events.
Publish sequence must stay in this order: move `model-catalog/latest` to `github.sha` first, then run dev/publish_model_catalog.sh, so release assets match the merged commit.
`publish` authenticates with `secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN` (contents: write); the App token stays on `create-pr` for PR creation.
Breaks if skipped: untrusted PR code could move the release tag or overwrite release assets; assets could drift from the merged catalog.
Reruns of the push workflow are the retry path for publication.
applies: Any change to the job graph, triggers, or permissions of .github/workflows/update-model-catalog.yml.
says: Why did the model catalog release assets not update during pull request checks?
Model catalog release files should only publish after merging changes into the main branch.
Prevent pull request test runs from moving public release tags or uploading assets.
Ensure scheduled catalog updates open an automated review request rather than publishing immediately.
search: Model catalog release publication in .github/workflows/update-model-catalog.yml executes exclusively on push events to refs/heads/master. Pull request runs only validate catalog generation, while scheduled runs use the create-pr job with an App token to open review PRs. The publish job authenticates with secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN, advances model-catalog/latest to github.sha, and executes dev/publish_model_catalog.sh so release assets match merged commits. Publication retries require rerunning the master push workflow to prevent untrusted PR runs from moving tags or overwriting assets.
